personal.name: Ashutosh Dubey
personal.tagline: I build scalable, pixel-perfect mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript, from fintech and banking to AI-powered developer tools.

about.heading: Crafting mobile experiences that feel native and scale
paragraphs: I'm a React Native developer with 7+ years of experience delivering scalable mobile apps across fintech, banking, health and social media.

Today I'm a Software Development Engineer II at Airtel Payments Bank, where I build key modules of the Airtel Thanks App, shape core app architecture, and lead a team building a reusable Design System and Widget Library.
Lately I've been building AI-powered developer tools with AWS, Amazon Bedrock Agents, Strands Agents, MCP and RAG, including Picasso, a Figma-to-code tool.
highlights: Led a team of 7 to build a Design System & Widget Library with Storybook
Cut development time by 30% with reusable widget components
Adopted React Native's New Architecture with Turbo Modules
Built Picasso, an AI Figma-to-code tool using Bedrock, RAG & MCP

stats.label: Engineers led on the Design System

points: Developed key modules (Rewards, DBT, Plans) for the Airtel Thanks App using React Native and TypeScript.
Built core app architecture with network wrappers, MMKV storage and deep linking with navigation, and adopted React Native's New Architecture with Turbo Modules.
Created and led a team of 7 to build a reusable Design System and Widget Library using Storybook, published on the Nexus repository for reuse across teams.
Reduced development time by 30% by introducing reusable widget components and the Design System library.
Built POCs for AI agents and AI tooling using AWS, Amazon Bedrock Agents and RAG with Bedrock Knowledge Bases; evaluated Kiro and third-party SDKs.
Created Picasso, an AI-powered Figma-to-code tool using RAG, Amazon Bedrock and Strands Agents, connected to Figma and Bitbucket through MCP.
Migrated legacy native flows (Wallet, Periodic KYC, Sweep-in) to React Native for better performance and maintainability.
Ensured on-time delivery through close collaboration with cross-functional teams, and maintained code quality through testing and reviews.
Integrated APIs and delivered pixel-perfect UI in coordination with backend and design teams.
Developed and delivered 5+ mobile apps across Health, Education and Social Media using React Native.
Resolved performance issues and ensured stable user experiences through clean, modular code.
Led a small team to deliver high-quality projects on time while following good architecture practices.
